name: Ashish Ahuja
player_statement:
A complete player, Ashish Ahuja has made a big mark in cricket. With 30 turns at the crease, they've hit a top score of 75*, with an average of 15.76 and a quick strike rate of 184.83. Their knack for hitting big shots is evident with 30 sixes and 7 fours.

Equally good at bowling, they've bowled 22.0 overs, taking 3 wickets at an economy rate of 13.73. Despite a few wides, their accuracy is top-notch, making them a key player for their team.
